confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Seattle price levels, not checked against live menus, listings, or booking pages. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies more by neighbourhood and season. The midrange_meal_2p anchor assumes tax is included and US-style tipping is not on the bill. The FX observation was taken from search-result summaries that cite the RBA exchange-rates table; I did not open the rba.gov.au page directly, so the figure should be verified against it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against major US West Coast metro price levels, such as Portland, Oregon, adjusted for Seattle's higher restaurant and hotel costs. No single comparable city was used.
